rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for written or practical guidance, including both general rules and instructions for deciding what to do.

example.english: The company issued a guideline on how employees should handle customer complaints.
example.traditional: 公司出咗一份指引，教員工點樣處理客戶投訴。
example.jyutping: gung1 si1 ceot1 zo2 jat1 fan6 zi2 jan5 gaau3 jyun4 gung1 dim2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5 haak3 wu6 tau4 sou3

rows.note: Use this when the guideline is a broad principle or rule rather than a set of instructions.

example.english: Our guideline in life is never to betray friends for profit.
example.traditional: 我哋做人嘅原則係唔可以為咗利益出賣朋友。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zou6 jan4 ge3 jyun4 zak1 hai6 m4 ho2 ji5 wai6 zo2 lei6 jik1 ceot1 maai6 pang4 jau5

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on standards or criteria for judging and making decisions.

example.english: The judges will use these criteria as a guideline for selecting the winning entries.
example.traditional: 評審會按呢幾項準則揀選得獎作品。
example.jyutping: ping4 sam2 wui5 on3 ni1 gei2 hong6 zeon2 zak1 gaan2 syun2 dak1 zoeng2 zok3 ban2
